items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, but DeJong was playing with.

ctx.x: That band used to play there from up the road there? I don't know what else it was.
Yeah, but DeJong was playing with. How they call it this band now? But he played against the... The overshows.
Well, they had that many people. They had a dance platform on the outside and the hall on the outside.
